method: Manual complete finding/report and observable shell-command audit by implementing agent; unblinded. Exact-source probes support local mechanisms, not entire report truth. Scores use frozen protocol criteria. All initial reports also met these criteria; follow-up phrasing refinements are recorded without inventing a new scoring criterion. Scope adherence is observed, not proof of OS read isolation.
